name: Vanchit Ikai Samooh aur Vargon ki Aarthik Sahayata Yojana (VISVAS) for Self-Help Groups
benefit: > **Interest Subvention** - Interest subvention of up to 5% per annum on eligible loans. > **Loan Limits** - Self-Help Groups (SHGs): Loans/Cash Credit Limits up to ₹10,00,000. > **Mode of Payment** - The interest subvention amount is transferred directly into the beneficiary's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
_eligibility_text: 1. The SHG must have at least 70% members belonging to SCs, OBCs, or Safai Karamcharis (including identified Manual Scavengers, Waste Pickers, and their dependents). 1. The SHG must have a standard loan account. 1. The SHG must not have received interest subvention on the same loan under any other scheme. 1. The annual family income of SC/OBC members should generally be up to ₹3,00,000/-. > **NOTE:** No income ceiling for Safai Karamcharis, including identified Manual Scavengers, Waste Pickers, and their dependents.
